shortDescription: Change firmware level on Managed Systems

options.name: action
options.description: C(accept) accepts firmware level for target system.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: IP address or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: level
options.description: Specify sss to retrieve a specific level of Managed System or Power LIC updates, even if disruptive. sss is the three character identifier of the specific level to retrieve. This is only valid when the LIC type is either Managed System only or Power only. Specify ccc to retrieve a specific level of Managed System LIC updates, even if disruptive. ccc is the three character identifier of the specific level of Managed System LIC updates to retrieve. This is only valid when the LIC type is Managed S

options.name: remote_repo
options.description: When the image repository needs credentials to be accessed remotely.

options.name: repository
options.description: The repository from which to retrieve the firmware updates. Valid values are ibmwebsite for the IBM service website, ftp for a remote FTP site, sftp for a remote secure FTP (SFTP) site

options.name: state
options.description: C(updated) executes an update on target system. C(upgraded) executes an upgrade on target system.

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system.
